frequency_question: How often do central bank liquidity adjustment measures or reserve requirement adjustments get announced and implemented within a designated four-month window when monetary conditions dictate liquidity absorption?
membership_rule: Includes all official central bank circulars, notifications, or press releases concerning incremental cash reserve ratios or equivalent liquidity absorption tools issued by the Reserve Bank of India between 2018 and 2025.

skeleton: Central bank policy cycles requiring liquidity management tools within an annual calendar divided into potential four-month implementation windows.
multiplier: 4 historical operational precedents identified across 24 possible 4-month windows within the 2018-2025 timeframe where liquidity absorption tools were actively considered or deployed.
validity_reason: Central bank operational frameworks, internal drafting procedures, and regulatory notification mechanisms remain stable over multi-year horizons.
